video_title: Stak Wants WNBA Rims Lowered. Jason Sudeikis Isn't Sold.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson suggests lowering WNBA rims to increase dunking
quotes.excerpt: I wish they would lower the rims, so they start dunking on each other.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: I wish they would lower the rims, so they start dunking on each other.

text_blocks.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
text_blocks.text: No, that's going to mess shooting up. I would say nine and a half.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: I don't want it lowered, but I think six inches lower would have more growth.

text_blocks.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
text_blocks.text: Okay, nine. But they already dunk on each other, they don't dunk on each other, they're not dunking on each other.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: For the record, I don't need it lowered. I'm just saying if they were going to.

quotes.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
quotes.summary_phrase: Jason Sudeikis questions the logistics of lowering WNBA rims
quotes.excerpt: Imagine a car full of 14-year-olds have to roll up to a gym and go, is this a girls' gym?

text_blocks.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
text_blocks.text: Imagine a car full of 14-year-olds have to roll up to a gym and go, is this a girls' gym or a boys' gym?

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Like he said, for the record, tennis is good with me. I was just saying if it gets lowered.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Barnes and Jason Sudeikis discuss injuries in SlamBall
quotes.excerpt: Tell me people got injured with that. 100% they got injured.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Did you watch the back, the ones that jump off the backboard, SlamBall? Tell me people got injured with that. 100% they got injured.

text_blocks.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
text_blocks.text: That's like the special ops thing. Someone got necked. Let's get it out. Leave that to the Phoenix Suns Gorilla.
